item.title: Teenage motorcyclist seriously injured in Kerry crash
item.description: A teenage boy has been injured in a serious crash in County Kerry. It happened on the N22 yesterday. The motorcyclist in his late teens was on a motorbike which collided with three cars at Lissivigeen at around 4 o'clock yesterday afternoon. Advertisement He is being treated for life-threatening injuries after being brought by air ambulance to Cork University Hospital for treatment. No-one else was injured. item.title: Old Coach Manor lights up for annual Christmas display
item.description: The Old Coach Manor estate will see its annual Christmas light display and community carol service get underway tonight. Thousands of visitors are expected to tour the lit up estate, with every home and tree fully decorated for the season. Saturday's event begins at 7pm and features carol singing, and a special visit from Santa Claus. Advertisement Residents will offer free festive treats, from mulled wine to hot chocolate. item.title: Local senator criticises Government solid fuel campaign as fearmongering
item.description: Cavan Senator Sarah O'Reilly believes the level of fearmongering directed at ordinary people who use solid fuel to heat their homes has reached "new and nauseating levels." item.description: A comprehensive victory over Caltra of Galway sees the Cavan side seal All-Ireland success. Sarah McCabe opened the scoring with a penalty after six minutes, giving her side the lead. Aoife McNulty followed up the goal with a point of her own a minute later from play. Whereas, Abbi Connor landed the first free of the game after 10 minutes, as Knockbride moved into a five-point lead. item.title: Male pedestrian aged in his 60s killed in Monaghan collision
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for witnesses following a fatal road traffic collision on Old Cross Square, Monaghan, Co Monaghan, which occurred today, Saturday 13th December 2025. Shortly after 10:15am, Gardaí and emergency services were alerted to the collision, involving a lorry and a pedestrian. The male pedestrian, aged in his 60s, was pronounced deceased at the scene.
